stage: S0.5 D0 capacity portion; native D2 capacity is a separate gate
length_definition: Exact native encoded prompt plus complete response plus supervised EOS; no padding-only inflation or truncation
workload: Deterministic observed bus/register episodes with independent per-bit solver; train8/dev8 per length and balanced answer classes0..7; complete world/source groups separated by role
starting_weights: Fresh sealed original for each length; the prior eight-update diagnostic winner is preserved
optimizer: project experimental Muon8bit with FP32 auxiliary AdamW

guard.action: Interrupt child and preserve available failure/profile evidence; terminate only if unresponsive
guard.limitations: Sampled safeguards cannot guarantee no OOM; host pressure/swap are system-wide; MPS and RSS overlap

acceptance: All actual train/dev sequences equal declared length with full answer and EOS
Every effective update covers all eight answer classes once
All original parameters eligible; finite losses and gradients; native names/shapes and changed original tensors audited
Mixed optimizer momentum remains INT8; one-step checkpoint restores native model/optimizer/RNG/order/schedule in a fresh process
Export/reload compares native logits within declared1e-5 relative/1e-6 absolute tolerance
No fallback, allocator-policy change or sustained threshold breach; memory/throughput and save/restore phases recorded
stop_policy: Do not start512 unless256 meets the scoped capacity checks; stop on scope, numerical, seal, guard or artifact failure and preserve evidence
full_size_continuous_vs_split_equivalenc: Not measured by these split capacity runs; native continuation and tiny CPU exact-equivalence evidence retain their distinct scopes
